question: Which of the following folds is a special type of fold with exceptionally flattened top and steep inclined limbs almost forming three sides of a rectangle?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Box fold**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The fold is a structure of a wave-like pattern which is formed by bending the rocks instead of breaking under any compression.
 
• These waves can be seen in stratified rocks which were formed because of sedimentary deposits on the flat horizontal sheets
 
• **Box folds are described as special types of the fold with exceptionally flattened top steep inclined limbs almost forming three sides of a rectangle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc5955745bdfc9f2fdc7fc64a6ffaf656a23f3257379e6e741d8051516def6a9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** three main types of folds** are **anticlines, synclines, and monoclines**.
 
• **Anticlines **are arch-like folds where the oldest rock layers are found in the centre.
 
• **Synclines **are the opposite of anticlines and are concave up, with the youngest rock layers found in the centre.
 
• **Monoclines **are folds where one limb of the fold is practically horizontal, while the other limb is steeply dipping.
